scope: Exactly the 132 first-oracle editorial findings in the archived 2024/2027 calendar comparison, grouped by cause. Do not apply these IDs as runtime overrides.
correctionPolicy: Any display correction must use the canonical principal source identity, never translated-name regex or date-specific feast invention. A Calendar display alias does not certify appointed Propers, commemoration or rubrical precedence.
